Ostrinia covariates-only results — 2022 test, ten seeds

Five architectures, three training regimes and paired seeds 0–9. One configuration per architecture is shared across its three regimes and selected using 2020–2021 validation. Fresh HPO and all final forecasts are complete.

Predict the relative 0–1 annual Ostrinia curve from weather, degree-days, calendar and static covariates. Ostrinia history and its observation mask are constant zero in all training, validation and forecast inputs. The 27 other features and graph are retained. Annual node-year maxima define supervised labels and evaluation only; forecast inputs need no insect observations or annual maximum. Batch 32, the 15-day lead and October exclusion are unchanged.

Fresh HPO: 30 configurations per architecture, screened on 2021 with seed 17 (80 epochs, patience 12). Two common finalists per architecture are rechecked on 2020–2021 with paired seeds 0–9 (120 epochs, patience 18). One shared configuration per architecture is frozen across the three regimes before the 2022 test.

Annual maxima define the labels only. The output describes relative annual shape; raw-count amplitude is not estimated. This report contains only the fresh covariates-only run. Earlier forecasting results are superseded for the current analysis.

Test result summary

Lowest mean MAE: GRU-GCN · Synthetic pretraining → zero-shot real · 0.07221 ± 0.00832. Fine-tuning has lower mean MAE than real training from scratch for 5/5 architectures.

Training regimeBest architectureMAE ± seed SD
Synthetic pretraining → zero-shot realGRU-GCN0.07221 ± 0.00832
Synthetic pretraining → real fine-tuningGRU-GCN0.07322 ± 0.00478
Real training from scratchGRU0.08886 ± 0.00530

MAE first averages observed targets within each node, then averages the three observed 2022 nodes equally. Each seed scores 549 node-date targets over 183 dates. Mean ± sample SD summarizes ten training seeds on the same test year. Each rolling forecast is made 15 calendar days before its target date.

2022 was inspected during earlier project work. The present selection does not use 2022, but the year is exploratory evidence rather than an untouched confirmatory test. A separate two-year evaluation remains future work.
